⚠️ Daily Digest Unavailable Today

Your client follow-up system is still running, but we couldn't generate your morning report today.

Why did this happen?

This usually occurs if Notion's servers are temporarily down, or if a critical column in your Notion database was renamed or deleted.

How to check your system:

  • Go to your Notion Clients database to ensure everything looks normal.
  • You can manually check the Today's Follow-ups view to see your active tasks for the day.
  • If you recently renamed any columns, please check the Schema Guide and revert the changes.
  • If this error persists tomorrow, check your Notion connection in Make.com (Credentials menu).

Your client follow-up system is still running, but we couldn't generate your morning report today.

Why did this happen?

The system encountered a database error while trying to fetch data for the step: Find Reply Logs (Names).

How to fix it:

  • Go to your Notion System Logs database. Check if you renamed or deleted any columns.
  • If you did, please check the Schema Guide and revert the changes.
  • If your database is fine, Notion might just be having a temporary outage. No action is needed.
